reuse.why: Extends the tree's applyWeekendRule/WeekendRule and getDateWithSkippedWeekend with holidays and adds a shared isWeekendOrHoliday, but the daily-skip decision is not given a shared predicate.

duplication.why: 'frequency === daily && skipWeekend' is recomputed in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template, and the skip-filter pipeline and search-window sizing (two different formulas) are repeated.

placement.why: Weekend/holiday moves live in shared/schedules.ts, but whether a daily occurrence is skipped is decided separately in server handlers and the budget template.

scope.why: Changes serve the four steps; only an import reorder and a release note are extra.

maintainability.why: Holiday matching is central, but a change to the daily-skip rule needs edits in four places, and two ad hoc search-window bounds can drift.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All moves go through applyWeekendRule/getDateWithSkippedWeekend and isWeekendOrHoliday; the daily-skip condition had no existing abstraction to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily-skip condition is restated with reordered operands and different names (skipsWeekendDays in app.ts, skipsDailyWeekends in schedule-template.ts, skipWeekend && frequency in getNextDate) instead of one helper.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains a holidays parameter and WeekendRule a holidays field; getNextDate gains a daily branch via getFirstWeekdayOccurrence; getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template each decide the daily skip themselves.
